name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: CRM Coordinator | Email Campaign Execution, Automation & Marketing Operations
summary: Marketing operations and CRM professional with 15+ years building and executing email campaigns, automation flows, segmentation, and A/B testing, most recently architecting 20+ live automation workflows on GoHighLevel and building email sequences and campaign assets at Level Agency. Comfortable managing multiple concurrent campaigns against deadlines with a technical, detail-first QA habit carried over from running SEO and structured-data audits. New ground, worth saying directly: no hands-on Klaviyo or Attentive experience specifically, no SMS-campaign execution, and no e-commerce/DTC brand experience, the platform and campaign-building fluency below transfers from GoHighLevel and HubSpot rather than the named tools.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, lead qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, and automated review-generation sequences.
Built segmented cold-email outreach engines in GHL (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews campaigns) plus an automated prospect audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts.
Draft clean, specific direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Track acquisition and retention across multiple accounts using GA4 and CRM analytics, delivering reporting that drives experimentation and growth.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced high-converting campaign assets, landing pages, complex email sequences, and conversion-focused copy, improving lead generation and pipeline.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
